newsitem.title: ITALY: INA says prepares Banco di Napoli bid.
newsitem.headline: INA says prepares Banco di Napoli bid.

text.p: Italian insurer INA said on Tuesday that it was preparing to bid for a 60 percent stake in struggling Banco di Napoli.
A statement said an INA board meeting had authorised its executives to prepare an offer to buy the stake together with Banca Nazionale del Lavoro.
The bid was conditional on proper contract conditions and to the participation of BNL.
The Italian treasury wants to sell 60 percent of the Banco di Napoli's stock and has given interested parties until December 20 to make offers.
The treasury took temporary control of Banco di Napoli after it unveiled record losses of 3.12 trillion lire in 1995 and plunged a further 674 billion into the red in the first half of this year.
Italian state-owned credit institute Mediocredito Centrale has said it also aims to submit a formal offer for the Naples bank.
